question: Iodine is essential for the synthesis of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Thyroxine**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Thyroid gland:**

 
 
• The thyroid gland is known to be the **largest endocrine gland**.
 
• The thyroid gland is** a bilobed, high vascular organ**.
 
• The thyroid gland is composed of follicles (round in shape) and stromal tissues. 
 
• Each thyroid follicle is composed of follicular cells, enclosing a cavity. 
 
• **Iodine is an important constituent of Thyroxine because it regulates the synthesis of thyroxine in thyroid glands. Hence, Option 3 is correct.**
 
• **Iodine** (in diet) is essential for the **normal rate of hormone synthesis** in the thyroid. 
 
• Deficiency of iodine in our diet results in hypothyroidism and enlargement of the thyroid gland commonly called **goitre**.
 
• When the rate of synthesis and secretion of thyroid hormones is increased to abnormally high levels then this condition is known as **Hyperthyroidism**. It adversely affects the body physiology of an organism.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Thyroxine hormone has the following functions in humans:**

 
 
• They maintain the basal metabolic rate of the body.
 
• They promote the growth of body tissues and the development of mental faculties.
 
• They stimulate tissue differentiation.
 
• Thyroxine also controls the working of kidneys. Its deficiency results in decreased urine output and vice-versa.
